name: Simulate Metabolic Network Perturbation
description: Construct and simulate kinetic models of metabolic networks and analyze their responses to perturbations.
detailed_description: Construct and simulate kinetic models of metabolic networks and analyze their responses to perturbations.
when_to_use: When you need simulate metabolic network perturbation analysis

parameters.model_file: [Required] Path to the COBRA model file (SBML format) (str)
parameters.initial_concentrations: [Required] Dictionary mapping metabolite IDs to their initial concentrations (dict)
parameters.perturbation_params: [Required] Dictionary with keys 'time' (float), 'metabolite' (str), and 'factor' (float) for perturbation details (dict)
parameters.time_points: [Optional] Number of time points to simulate (default: 1000)
